title: Tidal Island
palette: turquoise lagoon, pale coral sand, lilac basalt, sea-glass blue, soft warm cloud light
scene: A luminous remote tidal island at first-person eye level. A broad pale-sand path begins in the foreground and follows a dry curved causeway around a clear turquoise tidal lagoon toward an inland gap between pale lavender sea cliffs. Weathered basalt stacks, shallow reef pools, coastal grasses and pearl-colored rock, distant low islands and great soft clouds. No boats or buildings. Quiet wonder, clean traversable path, water kept beside the route.
wall: flat pale lilac gray weathered coastal basalt with subtle salt wear
floor: flat cream coral sand with fine wind ripples and a few tiny shell granules
secondary: flat shallow clear turquoise water ripple surface, no objects or landscape reflections
detail: flat pale porous coral limestone with tiny pearl and peach mineral pores
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat pale lilac gray weathered coastal basalt with subtle salt wear. TOP RIGHT: flat cream coral sand with fine wind ripples and a few tiny shell granules. BOTTOM LEFT: flat shallow clear turquoise water ripple surface, no objects or landscape reflections. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat pale porous coral limestone with tiny pearl and peach mineral pores. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
